<div style="margin:0 5px">Pins are an optional feature to make menu navigation easier. They are found in the menu at the bottom right by clicking the [[File:Setup Pins.png|100px]] button. Menus which have not yet been unlocked cannot be pinned.</div></div>

==Usage==
* Pins can be used for speedrun challenges, as they help you access certain tabs quickly.
* They also act as general convenience options.
* Some [[Cards#Misc card odds|Misc Cards]] require specific pins to be set in order to trigger

==How to activate==
# Enter the main menu
# Click the [[File:Setup Pins.png|100px]] button at the bottom right
# Choose three menus
# These three menus will remain on the main hotbar until you click the [[File:Setup Pins.png|100px]] button again
